summary: Technical documentation for third-party IDE AI agent hook integrations, including setup, payload specifications, and verification procedures.
responsibilities: Documents CLI command hooks for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes, Topchester, Opencode, Pi, and OpenClaw.
Provides instructions for local development testing via the 'clankerlog-dev' shim.
Defines expected JSON payloads for different agent hook events.
Outlines the logic for integration installation, environment validation, and manual fallback.
Specifies constraints regarding what agent data ClankerLog will (metadata) and will not (transcripts/secrets) collect.
